actions.title: confirm the released command boundary
actions.instruction: Run host Doctor and check the installed command catalog. This lesson follows the current read-only debug no-action contract; it does not require the old 2.15.1/0.7.2/0.8.1 cohort.
actions.rationale: The exercise depends on the released spike contract, not an Academy substitute command.
actions.expected_result: You know which plugin is loaded and can locate debug, spike, commit, and conflict.
actions.recovery: If your host is older or does not expose the command, update the integration or stop; do not imitate its output by hand.

actions.title: prepare the bounded attempt
actions.instruction: Run Academy Prepare from the clean training repository. It creates the U05 attempt branch and commits the observation fixture without changing the task board.
actions.rationale: Prepare supplies a reproducible input, not a simulated debug or spike result.
actions.expected_result: Academy creates a clean U05 attempt on academy/U05-debug-spike-conflict/1 with the committed observation and scenario files. Next safe step: read the observation.
actions.recovery: If Prepare refuses because the repository is dirty or a prior attempt exists, preserve that state, use Reset only after reviewing it, then retry Prepare.
actions.evidence: Prepare output, the new attempt branch, its preparation commit, and a clean worktree.

actions.title: read the prepared cache-key observation
actions.instruction: Read docs/U05-cache-key-observation.md before invoking a host command. It is a fictional Academy input, never output from $ca-debug or $ca-spike.
actions.rationale: The bounded observation makes the real debug question reproducible without a fabricated transcript.
actions.expected_result: You can state the observed behavior, reproduction boundary, expected no-action disposition, and spike question. Next safe step: run host-native debug.
actions.recovery: If the observation is absent or differs from the prepared fixture, stop and preserve the attempt; do not rewrite it.
actions.evidence: The committed prepared observation, with no debug.note receipt in it.

actions.title: run debug without code changes
actions.instruction: Investigate the prepared observation. A current no-action exit returns a cited explanation without writing a task, report, or production change.
actions.rationale: A no-action result explains source evidence without inventing work.
actions.expected_result: A source-backed conclusion and unchanged worktree.
actions.recovery: If the investigation is unresolved, retain that uncertainty. Do not force a no-action conclusion or write a task automatically.
actions.evidence: Observe the explanation in the session; Check cannot authenticate the conversation.

actions.title: Confirm debug left the repository unchanged
actions.instruction: Inspect status and the board diff. Both should be unchanged. Do not manufacture a debug.note entry.
actions.rationale: The board is durable plugin output; reviewing it prevents unrelated changes from being committed as debug evidence.

variants.command:
git status --short --untracked-files=all
git diff -- .codearbiter/open-tasks.md
git diff --check

git status --short --untracked-files=all
git diff -- .codearbiter/open-tasks.md
git diff --check

git status --short --untracked-files=all
git diff -- .codearbiter/open-tasks.md
git diff --check

actions.expected_result: No board diff or pending changes.
actions.recovery: If any pending change or board entry appears, stop and preserve the status and diff. Investigate why the read-only debug step changed the repository before continuing; do not manufacture a task or receipt.

actions.title: run the disposable spike
actions.instruction: Use the host-native spike command with the fixture question U05 cache key. Work only on spike/u05-cache-key and commit only its findings file there.
actions.rationale: $ca-spike discards implementation while preserving a bounded answer.
actions.expected_result: The host restates the bounded U05 cache-key question and pauses before creating spike/u05-cache-key. Next safe step: confirm that exact question.
actions.recovery: If code, a merge, or a pull request is proposed, stop; a spike has no implementation, merge, or PR exit.
actions.evidence: The prompt is transient. The durable evidence is the committed findings file restored to the parent; the spike branch must be absent at Check.

actions.title: confirm the spike question
actions.instruction: When the host restates U05 cache key and asks for confirmation, confirm only if it is the bounded fixture question and the branch is spike/u05-cache-key.
actions.rationale: $ca-spike stops for user confirmation before it creates the disposable branch or explores.
actions.expected_result: The confirmed host flow creates spike/u05-cache-key and on its answered exit commits only .codearbiter/spikes/u05-cache-key.md. Next safe step: restore only that findings file to the parent.
actions.recovery: If the question, branch, or timebox differs, decline and correct the prompt; do not let a spike start from an unconfirmed or broadened question.
actions.evidence: The prompt is not Check evidence; the findings-only commit and absent branch are observable evidence.

actions.title: restore only the committed findings
actions.instruction: Return to the Academy attempt branch and restore only the committed finding from spike/u05-cache-key. This is a native Git transfer, not a merge.
actions.rationale: The released spike contract permits the finding's contents to cross back but forbids the spike commit and exploratory code.
actions.expected_result: Only .codearbiter/spikes/u05-cache-key.md is now unstaged on the parent branch. Next safe step: review that one-file diff.
actions.recovery: If Git reports the spike ref is unavailable, preserve the state and stop; do not recreate findings or copy any spike code by hand.
actions.evidence: An unstaged parent diff limited to the one findings file.

actions.title: review the findings-only transfer
actions.instruction: Inspect the parent diff and stage exactly .codearbiter/spikes/u05-cache-key.md, then inspect the cached diff before committing.
actions.rationale: Staging and cached-diff review make the one-file transfer boundary visible before the commit gate runs.

variants.command:
git add -- .codearbiter/spikes/u05-cache-key.md
git diff --cached --name-only
git diff --cached -- .codearbiter/spikes/u05-cache-key.md

git add -- .codearbiter/spikes/u05-cache-key.md
git diff --cached --name-only
git diff --cached -- .codearbiter/spikes/u05-cache-key.md

git add -- .codearbiter/spikes/u05-cache-key.md
git diff --cached --name-only
git diff --cached -- .codearbiter/spikes/u05-cache-key.md

actions.expected_result: The cached path list contains only .codearbiter/spikes/u05-cache-key.md with all four findings headings. Next safe step: commit the parent transfer through the host.
actions.recovery: If any code or extra path is staged, unstage it and preserve the evidence; do not use a broad add command.
actions.evidence: Cached diff and path list for exactly the one findings file.

actions.title: commit the parent findings transfer
actions.instruction: Use the host-native commit gate to commit the reviewed parent findings transfer by itself.
actions.rationale: The parent commit is distinct from the disposable spike commit and preserves only the answer.
actions.expected_result: One clean parent-branch commit changes only .codearbiter/spikes/u05-cache-key.md. Next safe step: delete the disposable branch.
actions.recovery: If the gate blocks, keep the parent and spike state intact until its finding is resolved; do not merge the spike branch.
actions.evidence: A clean parent worktree and a distinct one-file findings commit.

actions.title: delete the unmerged disposable branch
actions.instruction: Review the committed parent findings, confirm deletion of only spike/u05-cache-key, then run this card. If the agent performs deletion, give it explicit confirmation first.
actions.rationale: The branch is disposable by contract, and Git correctly treats its unmerged exploratory commit as not merged.
actions.expected_result: Only the confirmed disposable branch is deleted.
actions.recovery: If the branch still contains unreviewed findings, stop before deletion; never merge it merely to make ordinary branch deletion succeed.

actions.title: honor the conflict stop
actions.instruction: If conflicting rules appear, use $ca-conflict to present exact sources and wait for the user's resolution before any further work.
actions.rationale: Conflict is a human decision protocol, not an artifact generator.
actions.expected_result: Work remains stopped until the person resolves the hierarchy conflict. Next safe step: resume only from the explicit resolution.
actions.recovery: Do not paraphrase a resolution or continue speculatively; present the actual sources and wait.
actions.evidence: Human acknowledgement is outside automated Check; no fake conflict receipt exists.

actions.title: check the accepted repository state
actions.instruction: Run Check after the findings-only parent commit is clean and the confirmed disposable branch is deleted.
actions.rationale: Check evaluates durable repository facts, never an alleged host invocation or conflict decision.
actions.expected_result: The preserved board and findings-only commit pass.
actions.recovery: Read the failed predicate, then return to the named boundary. Do not manufacture a transcript, receipt, or retained spike branch to force acceptance.
actions.evidence: Repository state, not debug invocation or deletion approval.

actions.title: reset a failed attempt before retrying
actions.instruction: Use Reset for a fresh numbered attempt after preserving failed evidence. It is not permission to discard work.
actions.rationale: A failed experiment should be recoverable without inventing or manually deleting evidence.
actions.recovery: If Reset refuses because the attempt contains state it must preserve, archive that state first and follow the refusal guidance.
actions.evidence: Preserved history and a fresh baseline.
